verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's own marketing says users can "set up automation rules" so mail is handled automatically, which is a first-party background automation capability. The evidence is a single repeated marketing line with no detail on triggers, actions, or how it executes. Zapier is a third-party integration and the gated API is a developer building block, so neither adds credit. Missing for 10: documented rule triggers/actions and their scope, evidence that rules run unattended in the background, a public automation reference, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Set up automation rules and have it handled exactly how you want.
